app.QnJldm8.action.Y3JlYXRlX2NvbnRhY3Q.d.source: Create a new contact in Brevo. Contacts can be created with email address, phone number (with country code), or external ID. Custom attributes and list assignments can be included.

app.QnJldm8.action.bGlzdF9saXN0cw.option.source: Order to sort lists by creation date.
app.QnJldm8.action.bGlzdF9saXN0cw.option.message: 按建立日期排序清單的順序。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.de.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Brevo** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.de.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **Brevo** 發出自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基礎 URL）、選填的查詢參數、標頭和請求主體。回應會以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應主體的雜湊返回。

對於尚未在此應用程式上公開為頂層動作的端點，請使用此動作。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/form/YAML 期望雜湊，XML/text 期望字串，multipart 期望檔案結構，binary 期望原始位元組。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構（filename + content + mime_type）。架構會建立 multipart 封套並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 原封不動地將主體傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項和值類型來決定序列化方式

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆蓋，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量（字串/數字/布林值）的雜湊。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 選擇主體序列化模式及對應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重新配置 `body` 編輯器 — 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart 表單會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx HTTP 回應會作為正常的相應雜湊傳回（帶有實際狀態碼），而非引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。有助於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 — 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆蓋連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 正常傳回非 2xx 回應而非拋出例外

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 視為成功的 HTTP 狀態碼選擇性清單。若有設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作會拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。若未設定，則套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為（通常：2xx 為成功，非 2xx 則拋出例外）。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些標頭會覆蓋由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭（例如，在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值）。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含 `debug` 子雜湊，其中含有請求方法/URL/標頭（敏感值已被隱藏）、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設為關閉以保持回應精簡。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 在回應中包含請求/計時/大小等除錯資訊

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain `{name}` placeholders that are replaced from `path_vars`. Example: `/users/{id}/comments`.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 相於連線 API 基底 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 `path_vars` 替換的 `{name}` 預留位置。範例：`/users/{id}/comments`。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain '{name}' placeholders that are replaced from 'path_vars'. Example: '/users/{id}/comments'
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 相對於連線 API 根 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 'path_vars' 替換的 '{name}' 預留位置。範例：'/users/{id}/comments'

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 代入 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}`，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。值均經過 URL 編碼。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.op.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會以 `,` 連接。

app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.sh.source: Make a custom API call to Brevo
app.QnJldm8.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.sh.message: 向 Brevo 發出自訂 API 呼叫

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.desc.source: Monitors your Brevo account for newly created companies. Optionally filter by companies linked to specific contacts or deals.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.desc.message: 監視您的 Brevo 帳戶中新建立的公司。可選擇按連結至特定聯絡人或交易的公司進行篩選。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.source: Optional filter to only trigger when companies are created that are linked to the specified contact.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.message: 選填篩選器，僅在建立與指定聯絡人連結的公司時觸發。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.source: Only trigger for companies linked to contact
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.message: 僅針對連結至聯絡人的公司觸發

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.source: Optional filter to only trigger when companies are created that are linked to the specified deal.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.message: 選填篩選器，僅在建立與指定交易連結的公司時觸發。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.source: Only trigger for companies linked to deal
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.optio.message: 僅針對連結至交易的公司觸發

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbXBhbnk.short.source: Triggers when a new company is created

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbnRhY3Q.desc.source: Monitors your Brevo account for newly created contacts. Optionally filter by specific lists to only trigger when contacts are added to particular lists.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbnRhY3Q.desc.message: 監視您的 Brevo 帳戶中新建立的聯絡人。可選擇按特定清單進行篩選，僅在將聯絡人新增至特定清單時觸發。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbnRhY3Q.optio.source: Optional filter to only trigger when contacts are created in the specified lists. If empty, triggers for all new contacts.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbnRhY3Q.optio.message: 選填篩選器，僅在指定的清單中建立聯絡人時觸發。如果留空，則會針對所有新聯絡人觸發。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbnRhY3Q.short.source: Triggers when a new contact is created
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2NvbnRhY3Q.short.message: 當建立新聯絡人時觸發

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.desc.source: Monitors your Brevo account for newly created deals in the sales pipeline. Optionally filter by deals linked to specific contacts or companies.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.desc.message: 監視您的 Brevo 帳戶中銷售管道內新建立的交易。可選擇按連結至特定聯絡人或公司的交易進行篩選。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.source: Optional filter to only trigger when deals are created that are linked to the specified companies.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.message: 選填篩選器，僅在建立與指定公司連結的交易時觸發。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.source: Only trigger for deals linked to companies
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.message: 僅針對連結至公司的交易觸發

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.source: Optional filter to only trigger when deals are created that are linked to the specified contacts.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.message: 選填篩選器，僅在建立與指定聯絡人連結的交易時觸發。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.source: Only trigger for deals linked to contacts
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.option.bG.message: 僅針對連結至聯絡人的交易觸發

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2RlYWw.short_des.source: Triggers when a new deal is created

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2xpc3Q.desc.source: Monitors your Brevo account for newly created contact lists. Triggers whenever a new list is created in any folder.
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2xpc3Q.desc.message: 監視您的 Brevo 帳戶中新建立的聯絡人清單。每當在任何資料夾中建立新清單時即會觸發。

app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2xpc3Q.short_des.source: Triggers when a new contact list is created
app.QnJldm8.action.bmV3X2xpc3Q.short_des.message: 在建立新聯絡人清單時觸發

app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.source: Remove contacts from a contact list by email addresses, contact IDs, or remove all contacts from the list.
app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.message: 透過電子郵件地址、聯絡人 ID 從聯絡人清單中移除聯絡人，或是從清單中移除所有聯絡人。

app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.source: Set to true to remove all contacts from the list.
app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.message: 設定為 true 可移除清單中的所有聯絡人。

app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.source: Array of email addresses of contacts to remove from the list.
app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.message: 要從清單中移除的聯絡人電子郵件地址陣列。
要移除的聯絡人電子郵件

app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.source: Array of contact IDs to remove from the list.
app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.message: 要從清單中移除的聯絡人 ID 陣列。

app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.source: Unique identifier of the list to remove contacts from.
app.QnJldm8.action.cmVtb3ZlX2NvbnRhY3RzX.message: 要從中移除聯絡人的清單唯一識別碼。

app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.d.source: Update company details including name, custom attributes, and associations with contacts and deals.
app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.d.message: 更新公司詳細資訊，包含名稱、自訂屬性以及與聯絡人和交易的關聯。

app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.source: Unique identifier of the company to update.
app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.message: 要更新之公司的唯一識別碼。

app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.source: Update custom attributes for the company including industry, size, website, and any custom fields.
app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.message: 更新公司的自訂屬性，包含產業、規模、網站和任何自訂欄位。

app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.source: Array of contact IDs to associate with this company. Replaces existing associations.
app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.message: 要與此公司關聯的聯絡人 ID 陣列。會取代現有的關聯。

app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.source: Array of deal IDs to associate with this company. Replaces existing associations.
app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.message: 要與此公司關聯的交易 ID 陣列。會取代現有的關聯。

app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbXBhbnk.o.source: New business name for the company.

app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnRhY3Q.d.source: Update contact information including attributes, email preferences, list memberships, and custom data. Contact can be identified by email, ID, or other identifiers.
app.QnJldm8.action.dXBkYXRlX2NvbnRhY3Q.d.message: 更新聯絡人資訊，包含屬性、電子郵件偏好設定、清單成員資格和自訂資料。聯絡人可透過電子郵件、ID 或其他識別碼來識別。

app.QnJldm8.desc.source: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is a marketing automation platform that enables businesses to communicate with customers through email, SMS, chat, and more. It offers tools for campaign management, contact segmentation, transactional emails, and customer relationship management. Brevo helps businesses build stronger relationships with their audience by providing scalable communication and automation solutions.
app.QnJldm8.desc.message: Brevo（前身為 Sendinblue）是一個行銷自動化平台，讓企業能夠透過電子郵件、簡訊、即時通訊等方式與客戶溝通。它提供行銷活動管理、聯絡人分眾、交易型電子郵件以及客戶關係管理等工具。Brevo 透過提供可擴充的溝通與自動化解決方案，協助企業與目標受眾建立更緊密的關係。

app.QnJldm8.short_desc.source: Brevo is a marketing platform for email, SMS, and automation campaigns.
app.QnJldm8.short_desc.message: Brevo 是用於電子郵件、簡訊和自動化行銷活動的行銷平台。
